Name: Game DVR Background Recording
Description: Controls background game-clip recording used by Xbox Game Bar.
Notes: Can be disabled for a marginal performance gain in some titles; effect varies by hardware and game.

Name: Visual Effects / Animations
Description: Controls window animations and visual transitions.
Notes: Minor performance effect on modern hardware; larger effect on constrained systems.

Name: Telemetry Reporting Level
Description: Controls the level of diagnostic data Windows sends to Microsoft.
Notes: Setting below the Windows edition's minimum supported level can be reverted automatically by Windows Update; Analyzer should validate the edition-specific floor before recommending a value.

Name: Menu Show Delay
Description: Controls UI menu animation delay in milliseconds.
Notes: Purely a perceived-responsiveness tweak with no measurable system performance impact.

Name: Power Throttling
Description: Throttles background application CPU usage to conserve power.
Notes: Disabling can improve foreground application responsiveness at the cost of battery life on laptops - Analyzer should check for battery/desktop form factor before recommending.

Name: Fullscreen Optimizations
Description: Affects exclusive fullscreen rendering behavior for games.
Notes: Ideal setting is title-dependent, not universally 'on' or 'off' - flagged for per-title validation rather than a blanket profile recommendation.

Name: Hibernation
Description: Controls whether hibernation is available and whether hiberfil.sys is reserved on disk.
Notes: Disabling frees the hiberfil.sys disk space reservation; has no runtime performance effect, purely a storage-reclamation option.

Name: User Account Control Level
Description: Controls the strictness of User Account Control elevation prompts.
Notes: Core security boundary against unauthorized privilege escalation. Never recommend lowering; not a legitimate performance-optimization target.
